tracks.title: University Institutional Language Second-Layer Corpus
tracks.why: The Season One post proves current/about-page and Wayback feasibility, but stronger claims need source genres beyond about pages.
requiredEvidence: raw manifests for each retained source genre
processed tables with source_layer and source_genre fields
readiness gate blocking cross-genre trend claims
post-evidence audit for any second-layer public claim
nextActions: Replace failed or low-word-count strategic-plan routes from the second-layer probe.
Add commencement speeches as a fourth source genre.
Backfill historical snapshots for retained second-layer routes.
Join source-genre tables into the main readiness gate after manual quote review.

tracks.title: Museum Annual Report And Provenance Source Layers
tracks.why: The Season One post proves public-page language feasibility, but stronger decolonization/provenance claims need annual reports, provenance pages, and exhibition texts as separate layers.
requiredEvidence: source inventory with page genre and source layer
raw snapshots with archive/current URL provenance
readiness gate requiring like-for-like source comparisons
nextActions: Replace inaccessible annual-report routes with report index pages, PDFs with extractable text, or archived copies.
Add provenance and repatriation targets for museums that currently only have annual-report routes.
Backfill historical snapshots for retained second-layer routes.
Join second-layer page-type outputs into the main readiness gate after manual quote review.

tracks.title: Humanities Literature Radar Broad Backfill
tracks.why: The ready dataset and remote smoke run prove the pipeline, but source coverage is still bounded for DOAJ, HCommons, OSF/SocArXiv, and NBER.
requiredSources: expanded Knowledge Commons Works / HCommons query coverage
department-page enrichment after topic map review
requiredEvidence: dedupe report comparing v1 and broad backfill
nextActions: Run the DOAJ OAI harvester with a larger or uncapped page budget for the full 2020-present harvest.
Add resume-token checkpointing before long OAI harvests.
Manually audit representative works before stronger field claims.
Rebuild, sync, and remotely verify the Alpha Research dataset bundle after the full harvest.

tracks.title: Cleveland Museum Full-Collection Backfill
tracks.why: The first public essay candidate uses a 5,000-record bounded sample from 68,743 available API records. Stronger collection-shape claims need a full or much larger backfill.
requiredSources: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access API full pagination
requiredEvidence: comparison report between 5,000-record sample and full corpus
audit packet for accession-year proxy and image availability
nextActions: Run a full-pagination fetch with resumable checkpoints.
Compare sample and full-corpus department/date/image distributions.
Update the publication caveat if sample bias is material.

tracks.title: Canon Drift Narrow Signal Pilot
tracks.why: The methods post proves that canon drift is multiple signals. The next study must choose one cohort and one signal layer before trend claims.
requiredSources: Open Syllabus export if terms are resolved
nextActions: Start with OpenAlex scholarly-discussion time series for the existing author cohort.
Add relevance filtering before comparing authors.
Resolve Open Syllabus access terms before assignment-level claims.

tracks.title: Humanities Dataset Registry File-Level Probes
tracks.why: The registry identifies ready-now corpora, but licensing, file-level access, and pagination must be checked before derived datasets are published.
requiredSources: Wikidata dumps or bounded SPARQL exports
Met Collection API object detail pages
Open Syllabus export route if available
nextActions: Probe file-level and pagination behavior for the top five ready-now candidates.
Add explicit licensing notes before publishing derived datasets.
Launch one additional ready-now study after Cleveland.

completionRule: This roadmap is complete only when every track is at artifact-ready, publication-ready, or explicitly blocked with evidence.
